                adj[i].append((i + 1) % n)
            elif d == '<':
                adj[(i + 1) % n].append(i)
            else:
                adj[i].append((i + 1) % n)
                adj[(i + 1) % n].append(i)
        
        # Recalculate in_degree based on adj
        in_degree = [0] * n
        for u in range(n):
            for v in adj[u]:
                in_degree[v] += 1
                
        queue = [i for i in range(n) if in_degree[i] == 0]
        removed_count = 0
        head = 0
        
        while head < len(queue):
            u = queue[head]
            head += 1
            removed_count += 1
            
            for v in adj[u]:
                in_degree[v] -= 1
                if in_degree[v] == 0:
                    queue.append(v)
        
        returnable = n - removed_count
        results.append(str(returnable))
    
    print('\n'.join(results))
